title: Se construyó en… y fue organizado por…
goal: a contar lo que se hizo con la pasiva en pasado (was / were + participio) y a marcar bien el acento

ex.t: The wedding was held in a beautiful old church.
ex.es: La boda se celebró en una iglesia antigua preciosa.

ex.t: My friends celebrated their fortieth wedding anniversary.
ex.es: Mis amigos celebraron su cuarenta aniversario de boda.

ex.t: A surprise party was organised for my birthday.
ex.es: Me organizaron una fiesta sorpresa por mi cumpleaños.

ex.t: We were invited to a wedding in Scotland.
ex.es: Nos invitaron a una boda en Escocia.

ex.t: Everything was organised by my son.
The parade was cancelled because of the rain.
ex.es: El desfile se suspendió por la lluvia.

ex.t: The cathedral was built in the Middle Ages.
ex.es: La catedral se construyó en la Edad Media.

ex.t: The Christmas cracker was invented in London.
ex.es: El petardo de Navidad se inventó en Londres.

pron.title: El acento de frase en la pasiva
pron.tip: Was, were, is y are suenan flojitos («wəz», «wə»). La fuerza va en el participio y en la información nueva: It's CELebrated in deCEMber. It was BUILT in the MIDdle AGES.

exercises.q: The wedding ___ held in an old church.
We ___ invited to a wedding in Scotland last year.
The parade was ___ because of the rain.
exercises.why: Was + participio. En británico se escribe con doble l.

exercises.q: Everything was organised ___ my son. He's brilliant!
The cathedral was ___ in the Middle Ages.
A surprise party ___ organised for my sixtieth birthday.
exercises.why: A party, singular y pasado: was.

exercises.q: The photos ___ taken by a professional photographer.
All the cakes ___ by my neighbour.

answer: The party was organised by my son.
The party was organized by my son.
exercises.why: The party + was organised + by my son.

exercises.q: The church was build more than five hundred years ago.
exercises.why: El participio de build es built.

exercises.q: The cake was made of my sister. She's a great baker.
exercises.why: Quien lo hizo: by. (The cake was made for my sister = para ella, también correcta.)

exercises.t: The cathedral was built in the Middle Ages.
exercises.es: La catedral se construyó en la Edad Media. (Fuerza en BUILT y MIDdle AGES; was, flojito.)
Nos invitaron a una boda preciosa
exercises.answer: We were invited to a beautiful wedding

exercises.q: La fiesta la organizó mi hijo.
answer: The party was organised by my son.
The party was organized by my son.
exercises.why: En pasiva: The party was organised by my son.

dialog.title: ¡Sorpresa!
dialog.setting: Yolanda le cuenta a su amiga Kate la fiesta sorpresa de su cumpleaños

lines.t: Amazing! A surprise party was organised for me.
Really? Who was it organised by?
By my son Hugo. All my friends were invited.
lines.es: Mi hijo Hugo. Invitaron a todas mis amigas.

lines.t: How lovely! Was there a cake?
Yes, it was made by my grandson. Chocolate, of course!
lines.es: Sí, la hizo mi nieto. ¡De chocolate, claro!

lines.t: Hundreds! I'll send you some tonight.

realLife.context: Para preguntar al guía en una visita a una catedral o un castillo

summary: Pasiva en pasado: was / were + participio
The party was organised by my son (by = quién lo hizo)
Pregunta: When was it built? · Negativa: It wasn't cancelled
Acento: was y were suenan flojos; la fuerza, en el participio
